passages.text: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness.
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
God created Adam.
God made Adam in His own likeness.
This is the record of Adam’s descendants.
passages.original: זֶ֣ה סֵ֔פֶר תּוֹלְדֹ֖ת אָדָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם בְּרֹ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אָדָ֔ם בִּדְמ֥וּת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
passages.sermon:
God created humans.
God made them male and female.
God blessed the male and the female.
God called them “man” on the day He created them.
passages.original: זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בְּרָאָ֑ם וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָ֗ם וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־ שְׁמָם֙ אָדָ֔ם בְּי֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָֽם׃ס

passages.text: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
God created Adam in His own likeness.
Adam lived for 130 years.
Adam had a son.
This son was in Adam’s likeness.
This son was in Adam’s image.
Adam named his son Seth.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י אָדָ֗ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּמְאַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בִּדְמוּת֖וֹ כְּצַלְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵֽׁת׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
Adam became the father of Seth.
After Adam became the father of Seth, he lived 800 years.
During these 800 years, Adam had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־ אָדָ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ שֵׁ֔ת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Adam was the first man.\r\nAdam lived for 930 years.\r\nAdam died.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֞וּ כָּל־ יְמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ חַ֔י תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
passages.sermon: Seth was a man.\r\nSeth lived for 105 years.\r\nSeth became the father of Enosh.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ שֵׁ֕ת חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Seth was a man.
Seth became the father of Enosh.
After Enosh was born, Seth lived 807 years.
During these years, Seth had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ שֵׁ֗ת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ אֱנ֔וֹשׁ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Seth was a man.\r\nSeth lived for 912 years.\r\nSeth died.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵי־ שֵׁ֔ת שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
passages.sermon: Enosh was a man.\r\nEnosh lived for 90 years.\r\nEnosh became the father of Kenan.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֥י אֱנ֖וֹשׁ תִּשְׁעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ קֵינָֽן׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Enosh was a man who lived long ago.
Enosh became the father of Kenan.
After Enosh became the father of Kenan, he lived 815 years.
During these 815 years, Enosh had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י אֱנ֗וֹשׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ קֵינָ֔ן חֲמֵ֤שׁ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Enosh was a man.\r\nEnosh lived for 905 years.\r\nEnosh died.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י אֱנ֔וֹשׁ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
passages.sermon: Kenan was a man who lived long ago.\r\nKenan reached the age of 70 years.\r\nAt that time, Kenan became the father of Mahalalel.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֥י קֵינָ֖ן שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ מַֽהֲלַלְאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon: Kenan became the father of Mahalalel.\r\nKenan lived 840 years after that.\r\nKenan had other sons and daughters during those years.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֣י קֵינָ֗ן אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Kenan was a man in the early generations after Adam.\r\nKenan lived for 910 years.\r\nKenan died.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י קֵינָ֔ן עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
passages.sermon:
Mahalalel was a man.
Mahalalel lived for 65 years.
When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he had a son.
Mahalalel named his son Jared.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ יָֽרֶד׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Mahalalel was a man who lived long ago.
He became the father of Jared.
After Jared was born, Mahalalel lived 830 more years.
During these 830 years, Mahalalel had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֗ל אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ יֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Mahalalel was a man.\r\nMahalalel lived for 895 years in total.\r\nMahalalel died.
passages.original: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י מַהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֤שׁ וְתִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.
passages.sermon: Jared was a man.\r\nJared lived 162 years.\r\nJared became the father of Enoch.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ יֶ֕רֶד שְׁתַּ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ חֲנֽוֹךְ׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon: Jared became the father of Enoch.\r\nAfter this, Jared lived 800 years.\r\nDuring these years, Jared had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ יֶ֗רֶד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ חֲנ֔וֹךְ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Jared was a man who lived long ago.\r\nJared lived for 962 years.\r\nJared died.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵי־ יֶ֔רֶד שְׁתַּ֤יִם וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃פ

passages.text: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
passages.sermon: Enoch was a man.\r\nEnoch lived for 65 years.\r\nEnoch became the father of Methuselah.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י חֲנ֔וֹךְ חָמֵ֥שׁ וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ מְתוּשָֽׁלַח׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Enoch became the father of Methuselah.
After this, Enoch walked with God.
Enoch walked with God for 300 years.
During these 300 years, Enoch had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֨ךְ חֲנ֜וֹךְ אֶת־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
passages.sermon: Enoch was a man who lived long ago.\r\nEnoch lived for 365 years in total.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֖י כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י חֲנ֑וֹךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.
passages.sermon: Enoch was a man who walked with God.\r\nGod took Enoch away.\r\nEnoch was no longer on earth.
passages.original: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ חֲנ֖וֹךְ אֶת־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵינֶ֕נּוּ כִּֽי־ לָקַ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

passages.text: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
passages.sermon:
Methuselah was a man.
Methuselah lived for 187 years.
When Methuselah was 187 years old, he had a son.
Methuselah named his son Lamech.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־ לָֽמֶךְ׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
Methuselah was a man in the Bible.
He became the father of Lamech.
After Lamech was born, Methuselah lived 782 more years.
During those years, Methuselah had other sons and daughters.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֗לַח אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ לֶ֔מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֤יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Methuselah was a man in the Bible.\r\nMethuselah lived for 969 years.\r\nMethuselah died.
passages.original: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח תֵּ֤שַׁע וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃פ

passages.text: When Lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
passages.sermon: Lamech was a man.\r\nLamech lived for 182 years.\r\nLamech became the father of a son.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ לֶ֕מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֧יִם וּשְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד בֵּֽן׃

passages.text: And he named him Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.”
passages.sermon:
Lamech became the father of a son.
Lamech named his son Noah.
Lamech said, "This son will comfort us."
We work hard and suffer as we labor.
The ground causes our pain and toil.
The LORD cursed the ground.
Noah will bring us comfort from this hardship.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֶת־ שְׁמ֛וֹ נֹ֖חַ לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֠ה יְנַחֲמֵ֤נוּ מִֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֙נוּ֙ וּמֵעִצְּב֣וֹן יָדֵ֔ינוּ מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽרְרָ֖הּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And after he had become the father of Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
passages.sermon: Lamech was the father of Noah.\r\nAfter Lamech became Noah’s father, he lived 595 more years.\r\nLamech had other sons and daughters during these years.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ לֶ֗מֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־ נֹ֔חַ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְתִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Lamech was a man.\r\nLamech lived for 777 years.\r\nLamech died.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כָּל־ יְמֵי־ לֶ֔מֶךְ שֶׁ֤בַע וְשִׁבְעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a man.
Noah lived for 500 years.
After Noah turned 500 years old, he had children.
Noah became the father of Shem.
Noah became the father of Ham.
Noah became the father of Japheth.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ נֹ֕חַ בֶּן־ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹלֶד נֹ֔חַ אֶת־ שֵׁ֖ם אֶת־ חָ֥ם וְאֶת־ יָֽפֶת׃
